description: Start here. Returns `sentToYou` first: bugs a person sent you with "Send to agent" (fix these first), then the prefiltered agent inbox: one row per signature group, new unique issues scored critical/high (or regressions). `id` is the best qualifying member. `member_id_sample` is at most 8 member ids; `instance_count` is the full count and `instances_path` lists the rest. Use this instead of list_bugs for what to work on. Diagnostic, silenced, and agent-acked rows are excluded.

since.description: ISO timestamp; only rows recommended after this
